ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a partial ladder diagram of a motor control circuit. On the left side there is first a stop button contact labeled “1SB-STP”, followed by a normally open start button contact labeled “1SB”; beside the start button contact there is a parallel branch, in which there is an auxiliary normally open contact labeled “1KM”; the right side is connected to a contactor coil labeled “1KM”. Reasoning: This topology is a typical contactor self-locking/holding circuit. After pressing the start button, the 1KM coil is energized, and its 1KM auxiliary normally open contact closes and bypasses the start button, so that after the start button is released the coil can still remain energized; when the stop button is pressed, the circuit is opened and the coil loses power. Therefore, what this circuit implements is the control function of continuously maintaining operation, that is, continuous control.

method.method_draft: Trace operation: initially the motor contactor coil is off. When the start button is pressed, current reaches the 1KM coil, so the 1KM auxiliary contact closes. When the start button is released, the auxiliary contact maintains current to the coil through the bypass branch. The motor therefore continues running until the stop contact is opened. Since the output remains on continuously after a momentary start command, the circuit performs continuous control.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是电动机控制回路的一部分，左侧串有标注为 1SB-STP 的停止按钮触点；其后有标注为 1SB 的启动按钮触点；启动按钮旁边有一条并联旁路，旁路中是标注为 1KM 的辅助触点；右侧是标注为 1KM 的接触器线圈。推理：初始时 1KM 线圈未得电，电机不运行。按下启动按钮 1SB 后，电流经停止触点和启动触点到达 1KM 线圈，使 1KM 得电吸合；同时图中的 1KM 辅助触点闭合，形成自锁/保持支路。松开启动按钮后，电流仍可通过 1KM 辅助触点旁路维持线圈得电，电机继续运行，直到停止按钮 1SB-STP 断开。由于该电路能在瞬时启动命令后保持输出持续接通，所以它实现的是连续控制。
